mapper.sql: id, code, name, parent_id, category, status, sort, created_at, updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM sys_permission WHERE id = #{id} AND status != 3

SELECT p.id, p.code, p.name, p.parent_id, p.category, p.status, p.sort, p.created_at, p.updated_at FROM sys_permission p JOIN sys_role_permission rp ON rp.permission_id = p.id WHERE rp.role_id = #{roleId}
SELECT FROM sys_permission WHERE status != 3 ORDER BY parent_id, sort
SELECT FROM sys_permission WHERE status != 3 ORDER BY sort
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_permission (code, name, parent_id, category, status, sort, created_by, created_at, updated_by, updated_at) VALUES (#{code}, #{name}, #{parentId}, #{category}, #{status}, #{sort}, 0, NOW(), 0, NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_permission SET name = #{name}, sort = #{sort}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE sys_permission SET status = #{status}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
